name: Ideal Customer Profile Builder
summary: Defines who to sell to first: firmographics, buyer roles, pains and disqualifiers.
description: Combines what you know about your product and early customers into a prioritized ideal customer profile with buyer personas, buying triggers and reasons to walk away. When Market Research runs first in the same package, the profile builds on its sourced findings, and every piece of evidence must cite one of those sources or your own input.
problems: I don't know which customers to target first
I want my first 100 B2B customers
My outreach is too broad and nobody responds
I need to define buyer personas

inputs.label: Existing customers
inputs.description: Short notes on current or pilot customers and why they bought.

outputs.label: Ideal customer profile
outputs.description: Segments, firmographics, triggers, pains and disqualifiers.

outputs.label: Buyer personas
outputs.description: Economic buyer, champion and user personas with goals and objections.

outputs.label: Evidence
outputs.description: Facts the profile rests on, each citing a research source or your input.

steps.name: Write profile
steps.responsibility: Produce segments, firmographics, triggers, disqualifiers and personas in the output schema, citing evidence.

steps.name: Check specificity
steps.responsibility: Reject profiles without numeric ranges, disqualifiers, key personas, or with evidence that cites unknown sources.

steps.name: Review
steps.responsibility: A separate reviewer grades whether a salesperson could qualify accounts with this profile.

dependencies.reason: Market findings make the segment choice evidence-based.

criteria.description: Profile lists at least two disqualifiers.
Firmographics use numeric ranges and the economic buyer and champion are defined.
Every evidence item cites a market research source or your input.
Specific enough to qualify accounts from public information.
